The request logging is now implemented in your Next.js app. Here's what I've set up:

## Files Created:

1. **`/vercel/sandbox/app/_middleware/index.ts`** - Global middleware that logs every request
2. **`/vercel/sandbox/app/api/test/route.ts`** - Test API endpoint for manual testing

## How It Works:

The middleware automatically logs every incoming request with:
- Timestamp
- HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
- Request path
- Query parameters
- User-Agent header
- Referer header

## To Test:

1. Start your development server: `npm run dev`
2. Visit `http://localhost:3000` or any route
3. Check your console to see the request logs

The middleware will log all requests including static assets, API routes, and page requests automatically.
